mechanism: Cefuroxime may increase urinary glucose excretion and affect renal function, potentially altering empagliflozin efficacy and increasing euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA) risk.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely, assess renal function, and watch for signs of euDKA (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea) during concurrent use; consider temporarily adjusting SGLT2 inhibitor if acute illness develops.
